title: Intervening event — a later event is carried into the running sequence
titleEs: Evento interviniente — Microescena con objetos y actores
description: Side-view model stage under a gantry: a pendulum starts the initial sequence of event tiles while a crane carries a later event’s tile along the beam and lowers it into the empty slot between two supplied events; the sequence continues through it per the supplied model (it reaches the vase, or it is held unresolved at a disputed link). As supplied; no legal test, causation, liability or outcome is stated.

content.note: Visual illustration only. It does not state the law of any jurisdiction or decide validity, responsibility or outcomes.

license: Original vector artwork and code created for this project; no third-party assets.

durationMs.description: Total length of the finite timeline in milliseconds. Phases scale proportionally; the final state is held.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

time.description: Optional relative time label, e.g. "T+2 min" (shown as supplied)

events.description: Initial sequence: the supplied events in order, from the conduct (first) to the last event before the loss (3–6) (array replaces the previous value)

label.description: Label of the additional event (fictional, descriptive)

time.description: Optional relative time label (shown as supplied)

after.description: It enters right after this event of the initial sequence (0-based). Kept between 0 and n − 2, so it always enters between two supplied events

from.description: Index (0-based) of the piece where the link starts

kind.description: sequence (default) or causal; a causal link is only drawn as such when supplied here

status.description: proposed (put forward) or disputed (contested); the animation never resolves it

causalLinks.description: Per-link data over the sequence AFTER the additional event has entered: link i joins piece i to piece i + 1 (the additional event counts as one piece; the last link joins the last piece to the loss). Links not listed are proposed sequence links. (array replaces the previous value)

link.description: Index of the link (as in causalLinks) it is put forward against

alternatives.description: Other events put forward by someone; drawn as a barricade beside a link, never decided (array replaces the previous value)

label.description: Description of the loss (label hypothetical amounts as hypothetical)

losses.description: Loss as described. The first entry is the object that is struck; an optional second entry is a smaller object beside it. (array replaces the previous value)

b.description: Caption for the crane that carries the later event into the sequence
